name: Kyoudai ~Futari~
source:
Main character's parents go overseas leaving him in charge of his sister for holidays. He wants to cheer his little sister up, but she urges him to fulfill old promise and treat her as an adult. These two weeks before her birthday get painted with the color of lust.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母出国旅行，假期由他负责照顾妹妹。他想让妹妹振作起来，但妹妹却催促他兑现旧约，把她当成人一样对待。距离她生日还有两周，她被涂上了情欲的色彩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
